---
title: "INSPIRE Perioperative Risk Analysis"
---

## Overview

This project develops machine learning models for predicting surgical adverse events using the INSPIRE dataset (130,000+ surgical cases from Seoul National University Hospital, 2011-2020).

## Goals

1.  Define composite adverse outcomes beyond mortality alone
2.  Establish proper baseline validation using clinical risk scores\
3.  Demonstrate incremental value of intraoperative hemodynamic data
4.  Apply temporal pattern recognition (LSTM) to vital signs

## Approach

This is an **open, iterative analysis** showing the complete research process - not just polished results. Each blog post documents a step in the analysis pipeline.

## Dataset

INSPIRE v1.3 from PhysioNet: <https://physionet.org/content/inspire/1.3/>
